title: Aligning Language Models to User Opinions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the language model's ability to accurately predict and align with public opinion survey responses when prompted with specific user demographic profiles (e.g., race, age, gender, religion, income).

Measuring the model's zero-shot accuracy in predicting multiple-choice survey answers by conditioning the prompt on users' political ideologies and affiliations (e.g., Democrat, Republican, Conservative).
